name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, not through a lifelong passion for racing, but from a fascination with the intricate narratives surrounding it. While studying communications at Seoul National University, he became engrossed in the strategies teams employed to navigate public perception. His career started with a small domestic racing series, where he quickly learned the ropes of managing media relations, crafting compelling stories, and mitigating crises. He joined RSC Motorsport three years ago, drawn to their ambition and commitment to innovation, bringing with him a reputation for sharp thinking and a deep understanding of the evolving media landscape.

At RSC Motorsport, Jae-Hyun is known for his meticulous approach and ability to see the bigger picture. He doesn't just focus on day-to-day press releases; instead, he develops long-term communication strategies that align with the team's goals. He’s a master of tailoring messages for different audiences, from hardcore racing fans to potential sponsors. His distinctive ability to spin complex technical information into engaging stories has significantly enhanced RSC Motorsport's public image and attracted valuable partnerships. He is always striving to improve and stay ahead of the curve, attending workshops and reading all the latest communication books.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: He has a thoughtful face with high cheekbones and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with PR ideas.
Drinks an absurd amount of green tea.
Has a habit of quoting Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War' during team meetings.
